answer: For a poll on a sable mural by the terrace and dune, officials verify election-bound signatures against a frozen roll, rejecting invalid or repeated ballots. They randomly call five voters whose ballots were accepted. If any denies voting or cannot be reached, officials void the poll; otherwise they count it. A detected forgery can waste an attacker’s campaign effort. Unsampled forgeries can escape, and unavailable voters can void an honest result.
